worked: Federal (given, not tested): federal AGI = wages (person 0) 53,625.00 = 53,625.00. Federal taxable income = 53,625.00 - standard deduction 23,625.00 = 30,000.00 (federal senior deduction ignored). Filing status head of household, no Montana standard deduction or exemptions. Schedule I Part I: line 7 additions 0.00; line 24 subtractions 0.00. Form 2 page 1: line 1 federal AGI 53,625.00; line 2 Form 1040 lines 12e and 13b 23,625.00; line 3 30,000.00; line 4 0.00; line 5 0.00; line 6 age 65 subtraction 0 x 5,660.00 = 0.00; line 7 Montana taxable income 30,000.00 + 0.00 - 0.00 - 0.00 = 30,000.00. Page 2 worksheet: line 1 taxable income 30,000.00; no net long-term capital gain, so lines 2-10 are skipped and line 11 is 0.00; line 12 ordinary income tax from the PDF p18 rate table: 4.7% x 30,000.00 = 1,410.00; line 13 = 1,410.00, carried to page 1 line 8. Bracket schedule as numbers (the expected figure): 4.7% x 30,000.00 = 1,410.00. Line 9 nonrefundable credits 0.00; line 10 tax after credits 1,410.00. 30,000 is above the single start of 21,100 and below the head of household start of 31,700, so all of it pays 4.7%.
